setup.title: Set up your practice
setup.description: Choose a tempo and input method. Starting practice opens a full-screen workspace with all 88 piano keys.
setup.waitHint: Notes pause at the play line. Play every note in the chord to move to the next step.
setup.microphoneHint: The microphone recognizes multiple notes at once. Use Free Run only; feedback is delayed by about 1–2 seconds. Audio is analyzed in your browser and is not uploaded. Place the mic near the piano and reduce background noise.
setup.freeRunHint: Notes keep moving at the chosen tempo; play as each note reaches the line to score Perfect.

micModel.ready: Listening is ready. The microphone is experimental: play a piano close to the device and avoid noise.
micModel.slow: The browser could not enable graphics acceleration, so listening may lag or stop; a MIDI keyboard or the computer keyboard is safer.
micModel.error: Could not load the listening model. Reload the page or choose another input.

midi.connecting: Looking for a MIDI keyboard… The browser may ask for permission to use MIDI devices.
midi.ready: Keyboard found: {devices}. Press a few keys to test.
midi.none: No MIDI keyboard yet. Plug it in over USB (or a MIDI adapter) and press a key.
midi.unsupported: This browser does not support MIDI keyboards (Web MIDI). Use Chrome or Edge, or choose another input.
midi.denied: The browser blocked access to MIDI devices. Allow it in the site settings and reload.

session.microphonePrompt: Play your piano; detected notes appear after a short processing delay
session.microphoneStatus: Listening and recognizing multiple notes · processing queue {latency}
session.waitPrompt: Play the notes waiting at the line to continue

micTest.title: Test Microphone
micTest.playPrompt: Play a few notes or a chord on the piano; results appear after about 2 seconds, as in practice.
micTest.unsupported: Browser does not support microphone input.
micTest.permissionDenied: Microphone permission denied. Please allow microphone access in site settings.
micTest.calibrateHint: Latency being compensated: {ms} ms. Press Calibrate and play one note on each click.
micTest.calibrating: Play one note on each click ({count} clicks)…
micTest.calibrated: Measured {ms} ms of latency and saved it; later microphone sessions will compensate for it.
micTest.calibrationFailed: Not enough notes were heard on the clicks. Play louder and clearer, then try again.

score.title: Score
score.subtitle: Play along with the score; note feedback appears as you play.

keyboard.label: Virtual piano
keyboard.title: Piano keys
keyboard.rangeHint: Some score notes are outside the 88-key piano range (A0–C8).
keyboard.computerRange: Computer keys play {from}–{to}; press Z to go down an octave, X to go up.
keyboard.outOfRange: Some notes are outside this range: shift with Z/X when you reach them, or practise one hand at a time.

keyboardGuide.title: Piano Practice Guide
keyboardGuide.keyboardDesc: Use letter keys on your keyboard to play. Matching keys are also labeled directly on the virtual piano keys:
keyboardGuide.touchDesc: Tap or click the 88 virtual piano keys. Tapping closer to the bottom edge produces higher velocity. You can also slide across keys (glissando) or use multi-touch.
keyboardGuide.micDesc: Place your laptop or microphone near your acoustic or digital piano (30–50cm away). Keep the room quiet. The Basic Pitch AI recognizes notes directly from your piano audio in real time.
keyboardGuide.handsDesc: Hand colors: Teal/Blue is right hand, gold/amber is left hand. Play when each note reaches the hit line.
keyboardGuide.stepInput: In setup, choose “Computer keyboard” to use letter keys, or “Tap the on-screen piano” to play by touching the piano.
keyboardGuide.stepRange: The on-screen piano always shows all 88 keys (A0–C8). Computer keys play one octave around the middle of the part you practise; press Z / X to shift down / up an octave.
keyboardGuide.stepPlay: Note colors indicate hands: right hand is blue and left hand is orange. Press the matching key when a note reaches the play line, or tap its on-screen piano key.
keyboardGuide.stepFeedback: Check the result below the piano: green means in time, yellow means early/late, and red means wrong note or missed.
keyboardGuide.keyMap: Computer keys play one octave using this map:

recovery.title: Another practice session is active
recovery.sameScore: This account still has an active session for this score. It was left behind after the page was reloaded, so its scoring position cannot be restored.
recovery.otherScore: This account still has an active session for another score. Only one practice session per account can run at a time.
recovery.sameScoreConfirm: Aborting the old session will mark it abandoned. Saved events remain in history, but the session cannot be resumed.
recovery.otherScoreConfirm: The old session may still be in use in another tab. Only confirm if you are sure you no longer want to continue it.
recovery.warning: After aborting it, you can start a new practice session on this page.
recovery.aborted: The old session was aborted. You can start a new practice session.

display.title: Practice display
display.enableKeyboardForTouch: Turn on the virtual piano to continue with touch input.

waterfall.title: Falling notes
waterfall.hint: Notes fall toward the hit line using the selected tempo and measure range.
waterfall.waitHint: The current notes pause at the play line; complete the chord to continue.
